messages:
marco: FYI we have two enterprise customers still using legacy API keys that have the old `sk-` prefix and full-account scope. New policy requires scoped tokens `rwd-` with least-privilege. They can't rotate quickly.
daria: are they failing auth or just refusing to rotate?
marco: refusing/slow. one is regulated pharma with a long release window. We get periodic alerts about exposed keys; security wants a migration path.
sam: short-term we could implement an auth exchange shim: accept `sk-` keys at the authproxy, mint a short-lived scoped token (STS) with reduced privileges, log the exchange, and respond with the new token in `X-Auth-Delegated` header. That avoids immediate client change.
lina: dangerous if we silently allow old keys forever. We need expiration, audit, and opt-in per-tenant. Also require that the shim only issues tokens with TTL <= 1h and rate-limited.
security-bot: note: any shim that restores access to long-lived keys must be tracked in audit logs and approved by security. See policy 4.2 (key-rotation-exceptions).
marco: agreed. proposal: tenant flag `legacy_key_exchange=true` plus header `X-Compat-Auth: exchange-v1` required from client to opt-in. Without both, reject old key with 401.
sam: exchange flow sketch: 1) client sends old `Authorization: Bearer sk-...` + `X-Compat-Auth: exchange-v1` 2) proxy validates old key -> create ephemeral scoped token via KMS-signed JWT 3) return 200 with `X-Auth-Delegated: rwd-...` and `Warning: 299 This is a temporary compatibility token` 4) emit telemetry `compat.auth.exchange.v1`
lina: include consent and visibility: we must create tenant-visible audit entry and email customer admin when first exchange happens. No plaintext payloads in logs.
marco: what about refresh or replay? If client replays sk- repeatedly we should fail after N exchanges per hour and require manual action.
sam: agree. enforce per-key exchange quota (default 10/hr) and per-tenant rate. Also emit `compat.auth.exchange.quota_exceeded`.
marco: other tradeoffs: risk of credential exfiltration if our proxy gets compromised. Mitigations: sign ephemeral tokens with instance-bound claims + short TTL + HSM-backed signing key and rotate that key frequently.
security-bot: enforce HSM signing and require hardware key usage for production rollout. Also limit the ephemeral token audience to specific endpoints.
lina: we should add an integrity header so downstream logs can correlate `X-Auth-Delegated` without revealing token: `X-Auth-Delegated-Hash: sha256(hex(token))`. That lets customers trace exchanges.
sam: implementation note: we can implement as a simple middleware in auth-proxy (Go) that calls a token-service endpoint. Token-service is already present for internal STS; extend it to produce scoped tokens with claims {tenant, scopes, exp, exchanged_from: hash}.
marco: rollout plan: 1) implement middleware behind feature flag 2) unit+fuzz tests for header parsing and quotas 3) deploy to staging, enable for internal test tenant 4) enable for single customer canary 5) monitor `compat.auth.exchange.v1` + token usage 6) schedule forced rotation deadline (60d) with customer.
lina: add metrics: total_exchanges, avg_exchange_latency, percent_exchanges_failing, exchanges_per_key. Also a dashboard and an alert if exchange volume > threshold (could indicate abuse).
marco: legal ask: need a documented migration SLA in the outbound notice to customers and an approval for sensitive customers.
security-bot: require a privacy checklist: no persistent storage of raw legacy key, redact before retention, and require customer signed consent for logging exchange payloads.
sam: error handling: if exchange fails, return 401 with body `{"error":"exchange_failed","retry_after":3600}` and an audit event. If token service down, return 503 to avoid silently allowing legacy auth.
lina: fallback policy: if the tenant flag is set but token service unavailable, we must not accept old keys—fail closed. That reduces blast radius.
marco: test cases: - valid sk- with opt-in header -> returns delegated token - valid sk- without header -> 401 - expired sk- -> 401 - exceed quota -> 429 - token-service error -> 503.
sam: telemetry event schema draft: `compat.auth.exchange.v1` fields: tenant_id, key_hash, issued_ttl_seconds, scopes, outcome(enum), exchange_latency_ms. All PII hashed.
lina: ops: add circuit-breaker and a kill-switch flag to disable exchange globally. infra-bot: can we schedule a canary window?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary slot open Tue 02:00 UTC. Canary key `canary/legacy-auth-exchange` created.
marco: final notes: timeline: prototype 7d, staging tests 3d, customer canary within 4w. I'll draft RFC and risk matrix. Assignments: @sam implement token-service changes, @lina implement middleware+quota, @marco own RFC & customer comms.
lina: one last thing: rotation helper CLI we can give customers to perform bulk key swaps. I'll prod devex to draft.
marco: perfect. thanks everyone — will post the RFC link here when ready. :rocket:
